page_note: Pure substrate teaching page: systematic anthropological-cosmological mapping of the soul's release from the body. The teaching maps soul-faculty → body-part (mind/bone, thought/sinew, teaching/vein, counsel/flesh, reflection/skin) and then constructs the New Man with five great living members corresponding to faculties (mind=love, thought=faith, etc.). All mapping is internal: cosmos-anthropology onto cosmos-anthropology. The polemic/ecclesial vocabulary hits are false positives — 'Error and Forgetfulness' are cosmic principles the soul donned (not anti-heretical polemic), 'Righteousness' and 'faith' are faculties/titles of the New Man (not institutional church terms). Heavy physical damage (72.7%) creates many fragmentary segments but the structure is unmistakable substrate.
